title: Cloud security posture management (CSPM) and configuration scanning

videos.script: Every lesson of this course ended with a setting. A bucket that should be private. A port that should be closed. {{settings}} Each of those settings can drift back the other way, quietly, on any day. {{drift}} This lesson turns them into rules that run without you. That is cloud security posture management. {{loop}} It reads the configuration through the API. It compares each answer with a rule. It writes down every place they disagree. {{faults}} First you build an account with four faults in it. {{scanner}} Then you write a scanner of fifty-six lines, and watch it find all four. {{exception}} One of the four is the public website, and that one is meant to be public. So it gets an exception, with a reason and an end date. {{fix}} You fix the other three, and scan again as proof. {{again}} Then caio opens a port for five minutes and forgets. The next scan finds it. {{products}} Last, the tools that do this for a living, in all three clouds. {{end}}
